points.quote:
However, unless you have explicit permission, you cannot use AI to:
•

Write or rewrite your work for you
points.gist: Without explicit permission, you cannot use AI to write or rewrite your work for you.

points.quote: Contribute to a viva or exam that is invigilated
points.gist: Without explicit permission, you cannot use AI to contribute to an invigilated viva or exam.

points.quote: Create images or code without acknowledging the source
points.gist: Without explicit permission, you cannot use AI to create images or code without acknowledging the source.

points.quote: Perform research tasks, such as generating data or acting as a source of factual information, without acknowledging the source
points.gist: Without explicit permission, you cannot use AI for research tasks such as generating data or as a factual source without acknowledging it.

points.quote: Paraphrase someone else’s work without proper citation
points.gist: Without explicit permission, you cannot use AI to paraphrase someone else's work without proper citation.

points.quote:
Unless specified otherwise, you can use AI to:
•

Get a general structure for an essay, presentation, or other work as a starting
point
points.gist: Unless specified otherwise, you can use AI to get a general structure for an essay or presentation as a starting point.

points.quote:
Help with research by providing an overview of a topic (just remember to
reference it if you use it in your work)
points.gist: Unless specified otherwise, you can use AI for a topic overview, remembering to reference it if used.

points.quote: check with your module leader and the assessment brief to see if it’s appropriate for that specific task.
points.gist: Check with your module leader and the assessment brief to see whether AI is appropriate for a specific task.

points.quote: if you’re working on a research thesis, discuss the use of AI with your supervisor.
points.gist: If working on a research thesis, discuss AI use with your supervisor.

points.quote: You might need to make a general statement about your AI use or include details of the prompts you used.
points.anchor: How to Acknowledge the Use of AI
points.gist: You might need to make a general statement about AI use or include details of the prompts used.

points.quote: Information you provide to an AI tool might be stored and used by others, so avoid sharing personal or sensitive details with AI.
points.gist: Information given to an AI tool might be stored and used by others, so avoid sharing personal or sensitive details.

points.quote:
Even the references it generates might be fake or wrongly
interpreted. Always double-check and critically review any factual information
produced by AI.
points.gist: AI-generated references might be fake or misinterpreted; always double-check and critically review factual information from AI.

points.quote:
If you fail to follow this guidance there is a risk that your work may be considered an
instance of academic misconduct.
points.gist: Failing to follow this guidance risks your work being considered academic misconduct.

points.quote: the University’s AI SkillsGuide provides instructions on how to reference it.
points.anchor: How to Acknowledge the Use of AI
points.gist: The University's AI SkillsGuide provides instructions on how to reference AI-generated content.
